footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Shell: after $282M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 5.3% to $273.7B in 2025. Operating income fell 0.8% to $34.4B, a 12.6% margin.
Net income rose 10.8% to $17.8B, or $3.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $42.9B and free cash flow $23.9B, versus $35.1B; Shell returned $22.4B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Shell plc Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
